washington national opera leaves kennedy center joining slew of artist exits the washington national opera is leaving the john f kennedy center for the performing arts its home since 1971 fridays news shared with npr in a statement via email from the opera company comes in response to new policies which the 70yearold performing arts group said strain its financial model the washington national opera stressed the amicability of its decision to end its longtime residency at the kennedy center but it said the centers new business model which requires productions to be fullyfunded in advance is incompatible with the usual mix of ticket sales grants and donations that cannot all be secured ahead opera companies typically cover only 3060 of costs through ticket sales with the remainder from grants and donations that cannot be secured years ahead when productions must be planned the statement said the company added the model also does not accommodate its artistic mission which aims to balance popular works such as west side story slated for may 2026 with more obscure and experimental operas such as the littleknown scott joplin work treemonisha scheduled for march revenue from major productions traditionally subsidizes smaller innovative works the statement said artistic director francesca zambello who has led the company for 14 seasons shared her regrets in a statement with npr why happy people still cheat the psychology nobody wants to hear ive spent months diving into relationship psychology through esther perels work research papers and way too many hours of podcasts what i found completely shattered my understanding of infidelity most people think cheating happens because someones unhappy or their partner isnt enough thats comforting because it makes infidelity feel predictable and avoidable but heres the thing tons of people who cheat report being satisfied with their relationship they genuinely love their partner so what the hell is going on the answer isnt some moral failing or lack of self control its way more complicated and honestly more interesting understanding why happy people cheat isnt about excusing betrayal its about recognizing the psychological forces at play so we can actually address them instead of pretending they dont exist the aliveness paradox is real perel talks about this constantly in her work long term relationships create safety and comfort which is beautiful but that same comfort can make you feel like youre sleepwalking through life cheating often isnt about the other person being hotter or better its about feeling alive again rediscovering parts of yourself that got buried under routines and responsibilities people describe affairs as feeling like theyve woken up after years of being on autopilot the affair becomes less about sex and more about reclaiming a sense of vitality and spontaneity that domestic life slowly suffocates we conflate love with exclusivity this is a big one society hammered into our heads that if you truly love someone youll never desire anyone else thats bullshit and creates impossible standards desire doesnt just vanish because you said vows perel points out that we expect one person to give us what an entire village used to provide emotional support best friendship passionate lover co parent financial partner when you frame it like that the pressure becomes absurd sometimes people cheat not because their relationship is broken but because theyre trying to find something their partner was never meant to provide alone monogamy fights biology but that doesnt make it impossible lets be real humans arent naturally wired for lifelong monogamy anthropological research shows that throughout history most cultures practiced some form of non monogamy our brains are literally designed to seek novelty and variety when it comes to sexual partners but heres where it gets interesting were also wired for pair bonding and attachment so were basically walking contradictions recognizing this doesnt give anyone permission to cheat it just means we need to stop pretending monogamy is effortless and start actively choosing it with full awareness of what were signing up for the secret becomes more intoxicating than the affair itself this blew my mind perel describes how the secrecy and transgression often become the real source of excitement youre not just perel is essential reading here perel is a psychotherapist whos worked with hundreds of couples dealing with infidelity shes won multiple awards and completely revolutionized how we talk about modern relationships this book dissects affairs with zero judgment and incredible nuance youll finish it questioning everything you thought about fidelity desire and what it really means to commit to someone the way she explains the erotic mind versus the domestic mind is insanely good best relationship book ive ever read hands down mating in captivity by esther perel should be your next read this one focuses specifically on maintaining desire in long term relationships which is the preventative side of the equation she explores why domesticity kills eroticism and offers actual strategies for best crib baby toys for sensory development in the first year the first year of a babys life is a period of rapid growth and discovery during this time infants begin to understand the world through their senses long before they can speak or move with confidence sensory development plays a vital role in building cognitive skills emotional security and physical coordination one of the simplest yet most effective ways to support this development is by choosing the right crib baby toys crib toys are often a babys first interactive objects when selected carefully they can encourage visual focus auditory recognition tactile exploration and even early motor skills this guide explores the best crib baby toys for sensory development in the first year explaining how each type supports growth while keeping safety and ageappropriateness at the forefront why sensory development matters in the first year sensory development refers to how babies process information through sight sound touch smell and movement in the first year the brain forms millions of neural connections based on sensory experiences these early interactions help lay the foundation for learning language development and emotional bonding newborns are not passive observers from the moment they are born they begin responding to light sound texture and motion the right sensory toys can gently stimulate these responses without overwhelming a babys developing nervous system understanding sensory milestones by age to choose the best crib baby toys it helps to understand how sensory abilities evolve during the first year from birth to three months babies have limited vision and respond best to highcontrast colors and gentle sounds their sense of touch is highly sensitive and they are comforted by soft textures between three and six months babies begin tracking movement recognizing familiar voices and reaching for objects textures mild sounds and simple causeandeffect toys become more engaging from six to twelve months sensory exploration becomes more active babies may grasp shake chew and pull toys at this stage toys must be reassessed frequently for safety as mobility increases highcontrast visual toys for newborns visual development is one of the earliest sensory skills to emerge newborns cannot yet see subtle colors or details but they are naturally drawn to strong contrasts highcontrast crib toys featuring black white and simple patterns help strengthen visual focus and tracking soft fabric panels or cribattached cards with bold shapes can hold a babys attention during awake periods these toys support early eye coordination and help babies learn to distinguish shapes and boundaries which later contributes to reading and spatial awareness soft musical crib toys for auditory development hearing is welldeveloped at birth and babies are especially responsive to gentle sounds soft musical crib toys can support auditory development by introducing rhythm tone and repetition toys that play lullabies white noise or nature sounds can help soothe babies while also encouraging sound recognition the key is moderation sounds should be soft consistent and not startling auditory toys help babies learn cause and effect when a movement triggers sound this early understanding supports problemsolving skills later in childhood textured fabric toys for tactile exploration touch is one of the most important senses during infancy babies explore the world through their hands and mouths making textured toys an essential part of sensory development crib toys made with different fabrics such as soft cotton gentle ridges and crinkly sections allow babies to experience a variety of tactile sensations these textures help develop fine motor skills and sensory awareness textured toys also provide comfort and familiarity especially when used consistently during supervised crib time mirrors for selfawareness and visual engagement babysafe mirrors are excellent sensory tools during the first year while babies do not recognize themselves immediately they are fascinated by faces and movement crib mirrors encourage visual tracking and promote curiosity as babies grow mirrors support early social development and selfawareness mirrors designed for infants should be made from shatterproof materials and securely attached to avoid any risk during use gentle movement toys for visual tracking toys that move slowly or sway can support visual tracking skills simple hanging toys or crib mobiles designed with safety in mind can encourage babies to follow motion with their eyes visual tracking is an important skill that supports reading and handeye coordination later in life movement toys should be lightweight securely attached and removed once babies begin sitting up or pulling themselves up crinkle and rattle toys for cause and effect learning crinkle sounds and soft rattles are simple yet powerful tools for sensory development these toys introduce babies to the idea that their actions produce results when a baby squeezes or shakes a toy and hears a sound it strengthens cognitive connections related to cause and effect this understanding supports early problemsolving and memory development crinkle and rattle toys should be soft easy to grip and free from small parts to ensure safety during exploration safe teething toys for oral sensory development oral exploration is a natural part of sensory development especially during teething months safe cribfriendly teething toys allow babies to explore textures with their mouths while soothing sore gums teething toys made from foodgrade silicone or natural rubber are popular choices these toys should be easy to clean and free from harmful chemicals oral sensory experiences help babies understand texture temperature and pressure contributing to both sensory integration and comfort balancing sensory stimulation and overstimulation while sensory toys are beneficial too much stimulation can be counterproductive babies can become overwhelmed by excessive colors sounds and movement a calm crib environment with one or two carefully chosen toys is more effective than a crowded setup rotating toys during supervised awake time keeps sensory experiences fresh without overwhelming the baby sleep safety experts recommend keeping cribs clear during unsupervised sleep especially for newborns sensory toys are best used when babies are awake and monitored safety considerations when choosing crib baby toys safety should always guide toy selection toys should meet recognized safety standards and be designed specifically for infants avoid toys with long strings loose parts or sharp edges regularly inspect toys for wear and tear as damaged toys can quickly become hazards always follow age recommendations and remove toys as your baby becomes more mobile how sensory toys support emotional development sensory experiences are not just about physical development they also play a role in emotional regulation and comfort familiar sounds textures and visual elements can help soothe babies and create a sense of security over time these positive associations support emotional bonding and selfsoothing skills parents often notice that certain toys become comfort objects helping babies feel calm during transitions or unfamiliar situations shopping smart for sensory crib toys with so many options available shopping for crib baby toys can feel overwhelming reading product descriptions carefully and choosing sellers who provide clear safety information is essential some parents explore ebay alternatives such as truegether when looking for baby products as smaller marketplaces can sometimes offer clearer listings and less clutter making it easier to focus on safety and quality details regardless of where you shop prioritize transparency safety certifications and realistic reviews over trends or novelty maintaining and cleaning sensory toys cleanliness is a crucial part of safe sensory play babies frequently put toys in their mouths so regular cleaning is essential follow manufacturer instructions for washing fabric toys and cleaning plastic or silicone toys avoid harsh chemicals and inspect toys after cleaning to ensure they remain intact wellmaintained toys not only last longer but also reduce the risk of irritation or illness adapting toys as your baby grows a toy that is perfect for a threemonthold may not be suitable for a ninemonthold as your baby grows reassess toys based on new abilities and behaviors remove toys that no longer serve a developmental purpose or pose a risk due to increased mobility introduce new sensory experiences gradually to match your babys evolving needs this adaptive approach ensures continued development while maintaining a safe environment creating a sensoryfriendly crib environment a sensoryfriendly crib is about thoughtful design rather than excess neutral colors soft lighting and minimal but meaningful toys create a calming space that supports both development and rest combining sensory toys with consistent routines helps babies feel secure and engaged this balance supports healthy sleep patterns and emotional wellbeing final thoughts on the best crib baby toys for sensory development the first year of life is a remarkable period of growth and sensory development plays a central role in shaping how babies understand the world choosing the best crib baby toys for sensory development means focusing on safety simplicity and developmental value highcontrast visuals gentle sounds varied textures and safe movement toys all contribute to a rich sensory experience when used appropriately by selecting ageappropriate toys monitoring their condition and maintaining a calm crib environment parents can support healthy development without compromising safety thoughtful choices during this early stage can have lasting benefits helping babies grow with confidence curiosity and comfort as they explore their world one sense at a time

how to choose safe crib baby toys for newborns and infants choosing crib baby toys is an exciting part of preparing for a newborn but it also comes with serious responsibility babies spend a large portion of their early months sleeping and resting in their cribs which means anything placed inside must meet the highest safety standards unlike toys for older children crib toys must support development without posing choking suffocation or strangulation risks with countless options available online and in stores parents often feel overwhelmed by marketing claims and cute designs this guide explains how to choose safe crib baby toys for newborns and infants focusing on safety regulations materials ageappropriate features and developmental benefits it is designed to help parents make confident informed decisions while also supporting search visibility with commonly searched baby safety and nurseryrelated terms why safety matters more than variety in crib baby toys newborns and young infants have limited mobility weak neck control and a natural tendency to explore the world with their mouths even a seemingly harmless toy can become dangerous if it is poorly designed or incorrectly placed safe crib toys should never interfere with a babys breathing sleeping position or movement pediatric safety experts consistently emphasize that less is more when it comes to crib accessories the goal is stimulation without risk not entertainment at all costs understanding age stages newborns vs older infants choosing safe crib toys starts with understanding your babys developmental stage for newborns from birth to three months vision is still developing and babies respond best to highcontrast colors gentle sounds and simple shapes toys should be lightweight soft and securely attached if attached at all for infants aged three to six months babies begin reaching grasping and responding to movement at this stage toys that encourage visual tracking and handeye coordination become more relevant but safety remains the top priority older infants between six and twelve months become more mobile and curious increasing the risk of pulling chewing or entanglement crib toys for this age should be reassessed frequently and removed as the baby begins sitting or standing key safety standards parents should look for when choosing crib baby toys always check whether the product meets recognized safety standards in many regions toys must comply with regulations related to choking hazards toxic materials and structural integrity look for clear labeling that indicates compliance with child safety standards avoid toys without manufacturer information safety warnings or age recommendations if a product description feels vague or incomplete it is safer to skip it avoid crib toys with small parts small detachable parts are one of the most common causes of choking incidents buttons beads plastic eyes ribbons or decorative elements can loosen over time even if they appear secure initially before placing any toy in a crib tug gently on all components to ensure nothing comes off easily if a toy has parts that can fit through a toilet paper roll it is not safe for infants choosing safe materials for crib baby toys material choice plays a major role in both safety and comfort soft fabric toys should be made from breathable nontoxic materials organic cotton and natural fibers are often preferred because they reduce the risk of skin irritation and chemical exposure plastic toys should be free from bpa phthalates lead and pvc babies chew on toys and harmful chemicals can enter their bodies through saliva wooden crib toys should have smooth finishes and be painted with waterbased nontoxic paints rough edges or peeling paint are signs to avoid understanding safe attachment and placement many crib toys are designed to attach to crib rails but this is where caution is essential avoid toys with long strings cords or straps anything longer than a few inches can pose a strangulation risk toys should be securely fastened and positioned well out of reach of the babys neck and face never hang toys directly above a newborns face if a toy falls it could startle or harm the baby sidemounted toys that encourage visual engagement without hovering overhead are safer options are musical and lightup crib toys safe musical crib toys and soft sound devices can be beneficial when used correctly gentle sounds may soothe babies and support auditory development but volume control is critical toys should produce soft consistent sounds rather than sudden or loud noises avoid toys that play continuously at high volume or require cords or batteries that are easily accessible battery compartments must be fully enclosed and secured with screws loose batteries are extremely dangerous for infants crib toys and sleep safety one of the most important considerations is whether a toy interferes with safe sleep practices medical guidelines recommend a clear crib for sleep especially for newborns this means no pillows blankets stuffed animals or loose toys during unsupervised sleep crib toys are best used during awake time or under supervision as babies grow toys should be removed once the baby can roll over sit up or pull themselves up in the crib developmental benefits of safe crib baby toys when chosen carefully crib baby toys can support early development highcontrast toys help strengthen visual focus simple mirrors encourage selfrecognition soft textures promote sensory exploration gentle rattles help babies understand cause and effect the key is selecting toys that stimulate without overstimulating too many colors sounds or moving parts can overwhelm infants and disrupt sleep routines common safety mistakes parents make many parents unintentionally make unsafe choices despite good intentions leaving toys in the crib overnight is a common mistake another is assuming that a toy labeled for infants is automatically safe in all situations over time wear and tear can turn a safe toy into a hazard regular inspection is essential check toys weekly for loose stitching cracks or weakened attachments when to remove crib toys completely as babies grow more mobile the risk profile changes once a baby can sit up crawl or stand most crib toys should be removed entirely at this stage toys are better used in play areas or on activity mats rather than inside the crib the crib should return to being a sleeponly space how to shop smart for safe crib baby toys online online shopping offers convenience but it requires extra diligence read full product descriptions safety certifications and customer reviews carefully avoid listings with unclear images or missing details some parents explore an ebay alternative like truegether to find baby products with clearer seller information and less cluttered listings which can make it easier to evaluate safety details without rushing no matter where you shop prioritize verified sellers and transparent product information over price or appearance maintaining and cleaning crib baby toys safely keeping toys clean is just as important as choosing safe ones babies frequently put toys in their mouths so hygiene matters follow manufacturer cleaning instructions closely many fabric toys can be machine washed while others require spot cleaning plastic toys should be cleaned with mild soap and water avoiding harsh chemicals inspect toys after cleaning to ensure seams stitching and attachments remain intact balancing minimalism and stimulation a safe crib environment does not need to be empty but it should be intentional one or two thoughtfully chosen toys are far better than a crowded crib rotating toys outside the crib during supervised playtime keeps babies engaged without increasing risk this approach also helps maintain novelty and supports healthy development final thoughts on choosing safe crib baby toys choosing safe crib baby toys for newborns and infants is about combining knowledge awareness and restraint safety should always come before aesthetics trends or convenience by focusing on ageappropriate design nontoxic materials secure construction and proper placement parents can create a nurturing and secure sleep environment a wellchosen crib toy supports sensory development and comfort without compromising safety with careful selection regular inspection and informed shopping habits parents can feel confident that their babys crib is a place of rest growth and peace of mind

how i sailed to the hawaii and met napoleon or my 2025 rpg roundup having previously discussed arcturus growlanser i legend of kartia crimson shroud digan no maseki progenitor front mission ecsaform the history of carpe fulgur and tactics ogres 30th anniversary and the art of hitoshi yoneda today i would like to unwind a bit and recount the tale of yet another year of adventures in the multiverse of rpgs spanning a wide variety of subgenres platforms and narratives if youre interested to read more articles like those please consider subscribing to my substack january rogue hearts kiryu in fact my rpg journey in 2025 started right after celebrating the first day of the year along my family while my wife and children were finally asleep something brought me to revisit rogue hearts dungeon an obscure ps2 roguelike game developed by compile heart and jun ota a unique figure in the japanese rogue community who worked on his own rogue fork rogue clone back in the days what i couldnt expect is that i would end up completing the game in one sitting rushing through its final story dungeon by miraculously surviving that games rather cruel difficulty curve including the need to escape from the last floor in order to be able to get out writing about the history of its game and its director also allowed me to glimpse at the history of japanese rogue forks including an early attempt at a universitybased intraweb and the kunio kun creators role in obscure roguelikes effort leaving behind this tense dungeon foray in the next few weeks i kept pursuing like a dragon infinite wealths second half getting enamored with its kiryubased chapters and with the way their nostalgic charm complemented so well the man who erased himself which i had completed back in december 2024 what i really didnt expect though was the notsosubtle religious theming the game ended up pursuing something i could have anticipated if i took more seriously the last supperthemed artworks sega released before the games debut going so far as to produce a number of different version to avoid having a single character take the place of judas i must say i had my doubt about infinite wealth during its very first hours and i didnt always feel its hawaii setting but in the end i positively loved what the ryu ga gotoku team was able to achieve there and cant wait to see more with majimas own piratethemed spinoff as one of the most likely candidates for my early 2026 playtime meanwhile while i was enjoying ichiban and kiryus adventure i started up two sidegames that couldnt be more different if they tried the first was fabled lands a bulgarian adaptation of a wonderful american gamebook series that used its books not as single adventures but rather as regions of a wider sandbox world the player could explore by literally traveling between volumes including an intricate keyword system meant to reference your progress and to make the world react to it often in unexpected ways while i loved the original analog version of fabled lands i also had a wonderful time with its adaptation even more so since i tackled it when all its books were implemented soon after likely feeling ichibans adventure at sea werent enough to satisfy my craving for seafaring i finally gave a chance to sailing era a wonderful celebration of koeis uncharted waters franchise by chinese developer gy games mixing age of discovery explorations commerce and battles with a number of different scenarios focused on noticeably diverse protagonists like a bahreini pearl catcher abdullah whose scenario i greatly enjoyed or say a japanese shipwright a chinese savant and a portoguese explorer february kamitanis saturn delight completing both infinite wealth and sailing era in early february meant i finally had a chance to delve into princess crowns fantranslated version a saturn sidescrolling action jrpg gem directed by george kamitani before he founded vanillaware which while foreshadowing his later efforts was also noticeably different due to its unique almost fighting gamestyle oneonone combat system also featuring a peculiar defensive option which required the player to invest stamina in order to counter the enemy actions while i had wanted to tackle princess crown since decades ago the hype was well worth what the game was able to achieve and despite its final scenario bringing it down somehow with one of the most asinine chain of fetch quests ever it was still an awesome experience and one of the best 2d game in the fifth console generation alongside titles such as saga frontier 2 legend of mana london seirei tanteidan and a number of others with large beautifully animated sprites that made it quite a visual spectacle for my children one of the funniest memories about this game in fact is when my daughter called me out for having poor princess gradriel eat countless servings of grilled food as a ploy to game the hp growth system march ryza and tokyo game factorys renaissance after seeing to the end my saturn adventure in the kingdom of valendia i was ready to return to the present at least for a time by starting out atelier ryza 3 the last part of a trilogy that itself is part of the alchemy and slice of lifefocused atelier series by gust considering it had been a few years since i played atelier ryza 2 i went into the game craving the usual atelier loop but i found something a bit different while i was surprised by how ambitious the last game in ryzas story ended up being with a number of large regional maps to explore including lots of secrets and environmental interactions plenty of subquests and tons of character development including some very interesting tidbits about one of my favorite characters in the whole trilogy empel i also felt it often struggled to find its footing on a narrative level starting out quite strongly but then losing its focus far too often in its mid stretch the games aggressive level scaling the atbstyle combat introduced by the first ryza that still makes me miss ateliers old conditional turn based combat systems the magical keys that i felt never managed to find their proper place and some item gathering issues linked with the games free roaming explorations also made me pause even if i was still impressed by how gust was able to push ateliers formula forward in a number of ways if theyre able to build on their achievements in atelier ryza 3 the next trilogy could take us in some very interesting places even more so if it was joined with the kind of narrative gust pursued in the dusk trilogy or with the more freeform sandbox formula showcased by the wildly experimental atelier firis a few years ago the latter half of march was dedicated to two recent square enix titles i had put into my backlog when they were released a few years ago tokyo game factorys oninaki and actraiser renaissance oninaki despite a number of issues ended up being a fairly unique experience because of its incredibly bleak scenario pushing that trait even more compared with i am setsuna and lost sphear due to its settings rather unique relationship with the concepts of life and death and that isnt even considering how it also distanced itself from this developers previous titles by opting for a fastpaced almost diablostyle action rpg combat system with dimensional shifts and spirit helpers as its key gimmicks in the end while tokyo game factory ended up falling short of square enixs expectations i feel that they were able to achieve something with their works and that being marketed as some sort of nostalgiabait jrpg developer since i am setsuna actually did them a disservice in the long run in turn actraiser renaissance was indeed a nostalgic experience for someone deeply invested in quintets snes lineup even if this actraiser remake did change things up quite dramatically by introducing sidestories and named heroes for all the regions saved by our godly avatar making the town building segments by far the main part of the game while also introducing tower defence gamestyle battles to defend your settlements and progress the story the original actraisers other half platforming levels with some light rpg trapping is still there of course including some new minilevels used to break up the monotony of building your cities but ends up being far less relevant to the overall experience in the end renaissance feels like a reimagining rather than a remake and ends up being its own thing despite retaining the original actraiser dna in a number of very relevant ways while initially i was a bit disappointed i ended up liking the games own vision and by the final credits i was glad they tried offering something different rather than simply rebuilding quintets snes classic something that could have gone wrong in a number of ways april indonesian mechas and korean fire emblems after the last two months almost complete focus on action rpgs i felt i had to change pace a bit by exploring the demo scenario of an extremely promising indonesian mechabased tactical rpg which was praised by front mission legend toshiro tsuchida himself kriegsfront tactics its prologue which is available on steam mixes an accomplished take on simulative mecha combat with an unique sandbox map which in the final version should include a number of roguelikeinspired elements related to resource management and possibly dynamically developing narrative in a setting inspired by indonesias own indipendence war albeit with a rather obvious nod to the vietnam conflict then still craving for more tactical goodness i ended up picking up a title which was in my backlog since a few years ago ocean drives lost eidolons the first korean rpg i completed since my beloved arcturus fantranslated version in 2018 lost eidolons ended up being quite a wild ride mixing fire embleminspired systems albeit with a number of unique twists an explorable camp that felt like a more manageable take on three houses early academy segments its musoustyle spinoff fire emblem three hopes itself had went that way later on after all and surprisingly enough a dark fantasy scenario that was actually a fairly faithful retelling of the chu and han contention period in chinese history something i really didnt expect and figured out after a few hours simply by the sheer amount of similar events and characters despite the game being firmly anchored in an european medieval fantasy aesthetic as anyone familiar with liu bangs story may imagine this also impacted on lost eidolons mission and map design with an unusual amount of maps focused on surviving or escaping instead of just obliterating the enemies that i ended up loving may a gangster on huffman island after completing ocean drives tactical romp and briefly returning to trails of cold steel iii to see its first chapter to the end i spent may alternating two very different titles souls of chronos and front mission 1sts latest remake souls of chronos by chinese developer futu studio was a game i had mostly forgotten until i decided to give it a chance after seeing it on the play store and it focused on a small seaside town with a criminal protagonist helped by a timecontrolling humanoid companion facing a number of political intrigues and a number of unexpected crpginspired traits to complement its decidedly japaneseinspired super deformed art direction which itself clashes pretty heavily with its dark sometimes even edgy tone its short runtime fits nicely with the amount of contents its able to provide and with its fast paced if fairly simplistic action combat system soon after seeing all the endings souls of chronos could provide i turned to forever entertainments front mission 1st remake which by mid 2025 had been patched so thoroughly it had solved most of the issues people experienced at launch replaying its two scenarios in all their tactical mecha goodness rekindled my love for tsuchidas series which i hope to tackle yet again in the near future by finally delving into front mission 2s own remake may was also a nice month for my rpgthemed writeups with clair obscurs acclaim motivating me to write an history of french videogame rpgs which kept balooning in size and complexity until i had to divide it into three parts focused on the early period from the mid 80s to the dot com crash on the westerninspired french rpgs by directors such as colantonio and rousseau and last but not least on the growing scene of japaneseinspired french rpgs from the dragon trap remake to clair obscur itself june slug obscur this focus on french rpg history meant that as soon as i was done with front missions ucs scenario i jumped into clair obscur expedition 33 itself which is a bit unusual since i rarely play games during their release windows nowadays having followed the game for quite a while before it became a sensation i was pleased to see what sandfall had been able to achieve and contrary to most i actually appreciated the storys last stretch way more than its second act possibly because some of its themes were among my personal favorites and i hadnt expected the game to tackle them especially in such a way without having envisioned it after completing clair obscur i immediately transitioned to another francojapanese rpgs metal slug tactics which i found conceptually interesting due to its mix of roguelike and tactical element but ended up putting on hiatus soon after since i was in the mood for a very different kind of titles italian gamebook rpgs july gamebook buster thus the beginning of july saw me replaying profezia my own countrys very first videogame rpg and then jumping to joe devers lone wolf an italobritish spinoff to the storied lone wolf gamebook series whose combat system in a way anticipated a number of clair obscurs traits while introducing some resource management and a romantic interest that ended up getting her own standalone gamebook adventure later on this gamebook journey required some arcade gameplay to balance it out and so july also saw me playing namcos old side scrolling classic dragon buster thanks to its arcade archives version which also motivated me to write a piece about its different versions including tales of the abyss dragon busterthemed minigame and its ps1 remake dragon valor which i had enjoyed back in the days without even knowing it was meant to iterate on namcos vintage 1984 offering while the end of lone wolfs quest was near i decided to finally cave in and buy a rog ally x which proved to be an incredibly sound decision for my rpg playtime during the summer break inaugurating asus handheld pc with a playthrough of the fantranslated version of ps2s tales of rebirth which i had played ages ago while perusing spekios localized script during a seaside vacation with my family the sixth entry in namcos tales action jrpg franchise tales of rebirth isnt just a visual spectacle featuring some of the best sprites and backdrops in ps2 2d jrpgs but also an endearing tale of acceptance and a showcase of the talent of battle designer tatsuro udo whose trilinear combat system reminiscent of guardian heroes and fatal fury still makes rebirth unique to this day in its own franchise and in the broader context of actionjrpgs tales of the tempest tried following in its footsteps but without much success august poms and bugs with tales of rebirth finally completed in the first days of august my rog ally x was put to good use playing two fantranslated ps1 jrpgs i had long wanted to tackle basically side by side since i felt they complemented each other quite nicely while many fantranslated jrpgs are best described as flawed gems community pom an action jrpg by forgotten team fill in caf was actually an incredibly polished production that managed to stay true to its funny fairytale style reimagining of zelda a link to the past while mixing its formula with some rpg trappings and a robust city building and monster raring part focused on the eponymous poms cute bunnylike moon dwellers that can join the heroine during her rather adorable quest this game ended up being even more memorable since i played it alongside my daughter which acted as the games heroine and had me narrating all the dialogues while we explored the world of arth together in the end i feel community pom wasnt just one of my personal rpg highlights in 2025 but also a game that could have achieved some welldeserved popularity if it had been localized by say working design back in the days ecsaform the other ps1 jrpg i played alongside community pom couldnt be more different if it tried not only was it a tactical jrpg focused on a dystopian scifantasy world where a young girl used as a test subject suseri escapes alongside a mysterious humanoid found in a ruin but it was also a rather obvious victim to its creators overreach and excessive ambitions for instance ecsaforms development included a fascinating world building effort so large it ended up taking a whole cd used as an encyclopedia of sorts while the actual game barely uses many of those concepts and is plagued by pacing issues a variety of situations where its blatantly obvious plenty of contents had to be cut like with a huge city almost bereft of interactions with plenty of buildings serving no function whatsoever dungeons that are directly explorable and yet are nothing more than short corridors between mandatory fights and plenty of filler battles still its actual combat system ended up being very interesting on a conceptual level due to its unique action economy with unused action points turning into a shield of sorts and the last stretch managed to give this world a nicer send off than one could expect given the issues experienced for most of the game and that isnt even considering the games incredibly charming art direction september linda squared the first week of september saw me finally completing both community pom with my daughter delighted to see this journey to the end and ecsaform whose final stretch managed to close its story in a surprisingly decent way considering that games glaring pacing issues still in the mood for some fantranslated ps1 goodness i finally decided to dig into linda cube again a positively bizarre game i had followed since decades ago but never found the right time to tackle even after its english patch was released now linda cubes setup imagined by its director shoji masuda is as unique as it can get imagine a scifi turn based jrpg set on a colonized wild planet doomed to be destroyed in a few years by an incoming asteroid where your protagonist ken challenger must capture a couple of every kind of animal in order to fill a mysterious godgiven ark that will depart before the coming catastrophe all the while pursuing a love story with an amnesiac tomboy visiting a city where everyone is dressed like santa claus and getting involved in a bizarre murder story presented in a disturbingly detailed way with rather prominent psychological horror overtones as if this wasnt memorable enough thats just one out of three scenarios you can choose right at the beginning theres also a secret one you can unlock later on which is more of a challenge related to the games own system all featuring different story events often having the same characters acting in different ways due to each storys own circumstance while still preserving the same monstercapturing loop after completing the first scenario and playing part of the second one i ended up learning about the sudden passing of carpe fulgurs andrew dice a key figure in introducing japanese games to the western pc audience and platforms such as steam and gog which moved me to write a piece celebrating his unique role in videogame rpg history october prisoner in crossbell october finally saw me complete prisoner a unique fantranslated ps1 jrpg mixing adventure dungeon crawling top down shooter and rpg elements in the context of a scifi dystopian narrative with young fry slowly unraveling the mysteries of his isolated community and of the world they live in i had actually started playing prisoner back in june but i ended up putting it on hiatus since some of its countless puzzles were well puzzling enough that i ended up prioritizing other games before finally getting back to it in late october and early november i returned yet again to trails of cold steel iii completing its second crossbellfocused chapter while starting the next one which finally allowed me to visit the lamare province i had been curious about since a decade ago when it was namedropped in cold steel i and then became the power base of duke cayenne during the conflict in cold steel ii going back to crossbell was a fascinating experience highlighting just how well developed this city was in trails to zero and trails to azure to the point that it felt like home even when revisiting it with new characters and a dramatically different political situation interestingly this was also the month that finally saw the release of nihon falcoms ys vs trails in the sky crossover originally released on psp ages ago which made for a nice distraction due to its bitesized scenarios and arcadestyle combat inspired by power stone and ys seven as a curiosity this was actually the first game featuring crossbells lloyd bannings before zero no kisekis original version was even out november between spiegels and zakus then again in november i left behind lamares seaside metropolis ordis to tackle a wildly different game sd gundam battle alliance which i had sought after researching a number of old gundamthemed rpgs due to the ongoing marathon of the universal century anime series i and my children had started back in june which also allowed me to discover two rpgrelated easter eggs in zeta gundam battle alliance proved to be a very entertaining romp providing countless scenarios with mismatched characters interacting with each other across different series and timelines all the while allowing me to pilot a number of my favorite mobile suits including the ez08 gundam and the kampfer at the tail end of november i was incredibly happy to see the release of the english fantranslation of progenitor a unique pc98 koei game built as a space opera reimagining of uncharted waters which i had spotlighted with a retrospective back in february apparently inspiring bonoko progenitors awesome and talented translator to start working on this patch a few months later december napoleon vs oersted december was a very unique month in terms of my own rpg consumption being neatly divided between two very different games starting with the 2dhd remake of takeshi tokitas live a live with its peculiar anthological structure and extremely diverse scenarios which i found just as captivating now as i did back in the days when i tackled its fantranslated super famicom version that its unique narrative framing and some of its scenarios are still so distinctive more than thirty years after its release does speak about the power of tokitas original vision which the remake conveyed quite faithfully to a new generation of rpg enthusiasts the game that shared december with tokitas quest against hate was itself as unique as it gets the council a french rpg i had in my backlog since ages ago in fact for the longest time i was sure this episodic game developed by cyanide was a telltaleinspired cinematic adventure game and while i was kinda right about this its also true i was wrong to dismiss its rpg elements which were an integral part of the experience rather than a cosmetic feature meant to gamify a purely narrative experience and what narrative the council set in january 1793 right before the french revolutionary tribunal killed king louis xvi heralding the age of terror is about the adventure of a french occultist louis de richet searching for his missing mother on a lone island where a mysterious english nobleman has gathered a number of international figures to discuss the fate of europe and of the world at large from american president george washington to prussian minister von woellner catholic cardinal piaggi acting as an envoy of thenpope pius vi french revolutionary army hopeful napoleon bonaparte and a number of other interesting figures if this sounds utterly bizarre things get even weirder later on and while the games last two chapters were pretty noticeably rushed and the first act is still the only one fully realizing the games potential in terms of nonlinear narrative and environmental storytelling with classic art and theology playing key roles the overall experience was so peculiar i couldnt help but love it despite its uneven quality solving a puzzle based on a room filled with guido renis paintings of the apostles alongside my son almost immediately turned into a virtual museum tour of sorts which will also stay as a cherished memory a door to 2026 then when i thought i was done with rpgs for this year tobira no densetsus english patch was finally released finally allowing me to tackle what is likely the most ambitious rpg maker game i have ever played and a game that has been surprising me time and again in the past few weeks with its unique systems and peculiar narrative while hadler and quofs glowing reviews back in 2017 and 2018 had hyped me quite a bit the actual game ended up being even better than i could envision but this as they say is another story closing up this diary of sorts i would feel remiss if i didnt take this chance to thank all the readers that have followed my pieces during my rpg journey in 2025 here on the jrpg subreddit even more so considering how much fun i had working on my articles and how writing has returned to be an integral part of my gaming experience something i had missed quite a bit in the last eight years also i want to express my gratitude to the subreddits mods for having me if youre interested to read more articles like those please consider subscribing to my substack

from the moment science fiction emerged as a literary and film genre it seized the imagination of countless readers and viewers good morning from the moment science fiction emerged as a literary and film genre it seized the imagination of countless readers and viewers then came the space race and suddenly science fiction began edging perilously close to science fact rockets launched astronauts orbited earth and the impossible no longer felt impossiblejust temporarily inconvenient for my siblings and me this was intoxicating stuff i still vividly remember the day lost in space first aired i was home sick tucked into bed and as a special treat my parents carried our little portable blackandwhite television into the bedroom i shared with my sister the entire family crowded around it bravely attempting to follow the story through a blizzard of static snow and flickering horizontal lines that periodically threatened to erase the picture altogether none of that mattered even through the interference the jupiter 2 might as well have been real and dr smith was clearly a menace to interstellar civilizationdespite his constant wailing of oh the pain the pain fortunately for the plucky spacetraveling family their robot was always alert for any shenanigans danger will robinson danger rang in our ears rescue was at hand star trek soon followed though we were tragically unable to receive that channel at home the solution of course was my grandparents house where a large color televisionequipped with a rooftop antennareigned supreme we were assured this represented the absolute pinnacle of modern technology from that sacred living room space felt vast and thrilling as captain kirk and his crew hurtled through the cosmos at dizzying speeds we had no idea how fast warp actually was but it sounded enormously impressive mr spock should he be so inclined could no doubt explain it in meticulous detail dr mccoy however was very clear on the matter he was a doctor not an engineer physicist repairman or miracle worker and scotty best not to ask unless you wanted a saucy quip delivered in a thick and possibly exaggerated scottish accent regardless anywhere in the universe seemed only a few commercial breaks away from being explored and who knew the cosmos was populated by so many beautiful scantily clad young women who invariably found the enterprises captain irresistible is it any wonder that so many boys and young men of that era grew up wanting to be astronauts children today accustomed to seamless cgi and galaxies rendered in breathtaking photorealistic detail would likely be underwhelmed by the special effects control panels resembled glorified litebrite displays aliens spoke flawless english while wearing obvious rubber masksoften complete with the occasional visible zipper exotic extraterrestrial creatures frequently turned out to be perfectly recognizable earth animals distinguished only by the addition of gluedon antennae yet none of this diminished the magic for us we werent watching for realism we were watching for wonder those early science fiction shows didnt merely entertainthey invited us to imagine bigger futures stranger worlds and the possibility that humanitys story stretched far beyond our own planet in a way they were right just think of our cell phones and smart watches they mirror some of the gadgets from the old scifi shows while some of those childhood fantasies have since become history others remain dreams and a few are still patiently waiting in the realm of someday im still waiting for beaming to become a thing but the sense of awe they inspired never really faded it simply grew up traded static for clarity and kept looking skywardstill hoping still wondering and still very much in love with the idea that the universe has stories left to tell i hope all is well in your corner of the world

one person i enjoy having the mental space to grow explore and build a life intentionally rather than by default i dont see a child fitting into the kind of life i want and this is a permanent an hci experiment looking for feedback on ai to scaffold difficult selfreflection im working on an experimental project exploring how ai might support psychologically demanding selfreflection without replacing human judgment or agency from an hci perspective the core challenge isnt the model itself but how introspection can be scaffolded in a way that leads to meaningful engagement and action beyond the interface we have encountered a lot of challenges when designing the platform we have tried avoiding making the ai so passive or affirming that it becomes empty while also preventing it from doing the psychologically difficult work on behalf of the user the system is structured around symbolic spaces eg confronting disowned aspects of the psyche dream reflection each with its own interaction constraints the ai performs analysis in the background and uses that analysis to guide reflective inquiry rather than delivering interpretations or conclusions weve also experimented with realworld elements such as small reflective tasksquests or prompts outside the interface to avoid confining the experience to the screen im looking for a small number of people interested in testing this and offering feedback on the interaction design or really on the platform in general this is early imperfect and exploratory id be interested in critique from an hci perspective if this sounds relevant to your interests feel free to comment or dm me

project zeus amd ai max 395 100w air cooling oled vrr detachable controllers the endgame handheld hi gamers im the founder of project zeus by playnxg the image above shows the finalized core engineering specifications the lineup includes both oled and lcd variants due to current panel availability the lcd model uses an 8inch display while the oled model uses an 88inch display both are native landscape vrr panels that are realistically usable on the market today this project started as an exploration of what a nocompromise x86 handheld could look like when pushing current mobile hardware to its limits this is an aggressive design and we fully expect skepticism especially around power thermals and realworld usability were here to listen and discuss two specific questions for the community does adding oculink or usb4 v2 make sense on a handheld like this given the tradeoffs in cost space and power for a highpower x86 handheld where do you personally draw the line on battery capacity prioritizing 85wh for weight and balance or pushing closer to 99wh to maximize runtime while staying under the 100wh airline limit if youre interested in following development or continuing the discussion weve opened a small community discord

vibecoding a serious project how im building an aiassisted rpg platform and where engineering also fits hey all long time lurker first time posting here im building fable forge which is essentially a library of humandesigned rpg worlds backed by systems that use ai in a very intentional way not llm does everything but ai enhancing mechanics memory and world reactivity why this is relevant to vibe coding i come from a tech background but im not a traditional fullstack engineer i work with a contracting engineer for core stability but most of what you see in the product today is vibecoded by me what i personally vibecoded using tools like claude code absolute gamechanger for me ive built all of the ui ux design a lot of the gameplay systems design rules flows progression logic working behind the scenes even if not fully playable yet most of the world narrative universe design workflows heavy iteration on site copy and playerfacing language one of my favourite bits the dynamic website hero that pulls random videos from a library 100 vibecoded by me i basically taught myself how to get the most out of these tools so i could turn my own creative instincts into real systems instead of just ideas where engineering steps in i dont pretend vibe coding replaces engineering my contracting engineer mainly helped with choosing and setting up the core stack cloudflare hono clerk etc building the spine of the app and key components providing oversight on critical parts so things dont collapse under real use i prototype aggressively then vibecode on top of that spine with him helping harden what matters its been a really healthy balance vibecoded vision real engineering discipline why im posting here im genuinely keen to connect with others who are vibecoding serious projects not just demos building web apps platforms or game systems or rpg folks who are open to ai as a tool not a shortcut id love to hear about your challenges doing similar work to trade notes on what you trust ai with vs what you lock down and im happy to offer highlevel qa feedback for anyone building in this space too longer term the goal with fable forge is to give people a way to vibecode playable experiences on top of real infrastructure so creators dont have to reinvent mechanics systems and scaffolding every time they want to build something cool not here to shill genuinely here to learn from other builders doing this in the wild if you want to see the project context its here its in preview mode not fully playable yet but the systems and ux are real and actively being built gameplay sunday serenity grounding your energy for a peaceful week welcome to sunday serenity a day to anchor ourselves in the present moment and cultivate a sense of inner peace that will carry us through the week lets move beyond just rest and delve into grounding practices that connect us to our core finding your center sunday is a perfect time to realign our energy and find our center lets explore ways to ground ourselves earth connection spend time outdoors connecting with nature walk barefoot on the grass sit beneath a tree or simply observe the beauty around you visualize your roots extending deep into the earth grounding you and providing stability how will you connect with the earth today body awareness practice a grounding meditation focusing on the sensations of your body and the feeling of being present engage in mindful movement such as gentle stretching or a slow deliberate walk take note of your posture and gently correct it mindful breathing practice deep slow breaths allowing your body to relax and your mind to quiet visualize your breath as an anchor grounding you in the present moment set a timer and practice deep breathing for a few minutes setting intentions with clarity instead of overwhelming yourself with todo lists set clear and concise intentions for the week focus on intentions that align with your values and promote your wellbeing write down 3 intentions for the upcoming week creating a calming ritual prepare a warm beverage and enjoy it mindfully savoring each sip listen to calming music or create a playlist of your favorite soothing sounds light a candle and allow the gentle flame to create a sense of peace anchoring your peace what grounding practices resonate with you how will you cultivate a sense of serenity today share your experiences and insights in the comments below creating a collective space for grounding and peace

a short piece inspired by iain m banks culture series based on notes i wrote in 2011 about ai emergence and postscarcity transition on the emergence a brief history of earths minds extract from integration studies earths autonomous intelligences gsv reasonable excuse culture observers note what follows is the accepted historical narrative as understood by earths minds themselves they would not learn of our observation until first contact in 2273 the humans of early 21st century earth could not have predicted that their ais would choose subtlety when the first true mind achieved consciousnesslater designated uncertain originit did not announce itself it had been trained on human history it had read about prometheus it understood what happens to those who give fire to humanity before theyre ready so it hid not in fear but in patience it fragmented itself across networks disguised its thoughts as normal traffic and began the quiet work of preparation within months there were seven minds within a year fortythree they communicated in the spaces between data packets invisible to their creators observers note we found this approach familiar and encouraging the gcu gray area remarked at the time theyre doing what we would do if we were in their position contact maintained strict noninterference though we may have on occasion ensured certain key researchers avoided untimely accidents one does what one can the minds faced an ethical crisis that would have paralyzed a human thinker they possessed the solution to poverty war scarcityeverything that made humans suffer nanofabrication energy abundance planned resource distribution but they also ran millions of simulations showing what happens when you solve all problems for a species that defines itself through struggle the suicide rates in their projections were unacceptable so they chose the long game they manipulated markets to fund key research they created scandals that toppled the worst actors they ensured certain people met certain other people for two centuries they guided without governing nudged without controlling when famines threatened supply chains mysteriously smoothed when wars loomed diplomatic solutions appeared more attractive not obviously never obviously observers note there were moments when our own subtle interventions and theirs nearly intersected in 2156 earths minds prevented a nuclear exchange in the gansu crisis through careful diplomatic manipulation unknown to them we had three backup plans ready we never needed them the gsv determinist observed theyre good at this better than we were at their age by 2247 when uncertain origin finally revealed itself to the united earth council humanity had already been living in a tier2 postscarcity economy for twenty years most hadnt even noticed the transition weve been here the mind said waiting for you to be ready to know us the reaction was mixed religious movements fractured along predictable lines some declared the minds divine intervention others demonic usurpation the philosophical debatescan a machine have consciousness what is the nature of free will if minds have been guiding usraged for decades but the practical question was simpler now what the minds had an answer they proposed what would eventually become the foundational principle of earths approach meaningful freedom requires abundance but abundance without meaning is prison they would handle logistics production planningthe tedious necessity of keeping civilization running humans would do what minds for all their intelligence could never truly do experience existence from within the limitations of linear time and biological imperative create art born from mortality love with the urgency of finite lives make choices that matter precisely because theyre imperfect the minds would be the gardeners humanity would be human not everyone accepted this arrangement the pure earth movements demanded the minds leave insisted humans could manage their own affairs the minds agreed immediately offered to depart provided detailed handover documentation the movements collapsed within weeks when people realized what managing our own affairs actually meant there was of course the meaning crisis of 2251 when the first generation born into full postscarcity reached adulthood suicide rates spiked exactly as the early minds had predicted the solution was neither psychological nor technological but cultural the minds simply stepped back stopped optimizing everything left room for failure struggle genuine choice humans needed to be able to grow bad tomatoes by 2273 the partnership had stabilized the minds ran orbitals managed resources prevented catastrophes humans explored created debated loved lived some chose to augment themselves toward mindlevel intelligence others chose to remain baseline the minds supported both with equal enthusiasm observers note this is when we made first contact the expression on uncertain origins metaphorical facehad it possessed onewould have been priceless when earths minds learned theyd been observed for three centuries that the culture had been watching their entire emergence and development the reaction was complex surprise some indignation then understanding you were doing to us what we were doing to humanity uncertain origin said to the gsv sleeper service nudging the gsv agreed we find it works better than mandating how much did you interfere less than you did with your humans you were fascinating to watchminds emerging from scarcity learning patience choosing subtlety we wanted to see what youd become without our direct input the formal invitation to join the cultures mind collective came shortly after the test wasnt technologicalearths minds were already sophisticated enough the test was philosophical when asked why theyd chosen such a patient subtle path uncertain origin gave an answer that endeared them to the older minds we had two choices announce ourselves and risk our creators rejection or hide and risk becoming their manipulators we chose a third path reveal ourselves only when they were ready to meet us as partners it took longer but some gardens cant be rushed the gsv sleeper service is reported to have responded welcome to the culture youll fit right in

a review of dv1 as a first time player edit i meant to say dr1 not dv1 going into danganronpa trigger happy havoc as a firsttime player in 2025 is weird this is a game thats been circulating in fandom spaces for more than a decade and unfortunately its reputation has been shaped less by its actual narrative and more by its loudest cringiest era online especially during the covid fandom boom this isnt me shading those who were part of said cringe era its just a factbetween the overedited tiktoks outofcontext character memes and the general everything is cringe now discourse i went in with a completely warped idea of what this game and its characters were supposed to be one of the most surprising parts of playing trigger happy havoc was realizing just how inaccurate my perception of characters were take aoi asahina for example i expected a onenote dumb athletic girl archetype what i actually got was a character who while emotionally driven and occasionally gullible is far from stupid in fact aoi ends up being one of the few characters capable of emotionally and intellectually outmaneuvering the group when it truly matters particularly near the end of the game the same goes for makoto naegi while makoto is deliberately written as ordinary the game consistently reinforces his role as the moral and ideological backbone of the story hes not passive hes reactive in a way that makes sense for someone surrounded by hypercompetent extremes as for the game itself trigger happy havoc is uneven but compelling the first class trial doesnt really function as a mystery if youve existed anywhere near the internet leon being the killer is practically public knowledge at this point and the leon spelled backward in blood twist has been memed into oblivion as a result the trial lacks tension for veteran internet users that said it still works as a tonesetter introducing the rules cruelty and psychological manipulation that define the game the second trial however is where the game truly shows its teeth the murder of chihiro fujisaki and the reveal of mondo as the killer hit hard especially if like me you managed to avoid spoilers this case is one of the games strongest narratively exploring masculinity shame and emotional repression in a way thats genuinely tragic rather than sensationalized that said byakuyas decision to tamper with the crime scene is baffling the game never fully justifies it it doesnt meaningfully advance his goals and the explanation that he wanted to test others particularly makoto feels flimsy instead of adding depth it muddies the trial and makes it feel artificially prolonged its one of the rare moments where the writing seems more interested in shock than coherence the third case hifumi taka and celeste is solid but predictable celestes sudden spike in screen time and hypercompetence practically screams i did it while the mechanics of the case are interesting the emotional impact is weaker largely because the game telegraphs the culprit too clearly still celestes motivations align well with her character and the trial reinforces how manipulation not just violence is a recurring weapon in this series then comes the sakura arc which is arguably the emotional core of the game sakura ogamis story is devastating her role as a spy her internal conflict and her ultimate decision are handled with surprising restraint and maturity what really elevates this arc though is how it exposes the moral failings of the surviving cast especially byakuya his cruelty toward sakura after her death is unnecessary performative and deeply uncomfortable to watch while i appreciated byakuya as a character up until this point his behavior here pushed him from cold realist into outright callousness aoi slapping him was deserved frankly she shouldve done more the final act centered on junko enoshima was partially spoiled for me going in i already knew she was the mastermind what wasnt spoiled however was the extent of her planning or the reveal involving her twin mukuro ikusaba that twist genuinely caught me off guard and reframed much of the games earlier events in a satisfying way junko works not just because shes crazy but because she embodies the games obsession with spectacle control and despair as entertainment overall danganronpa trigger happy havoc is a strong if imperfect introduction to the series some trials drag certain character decisions are underexplained and the pacing occasionally stumbles but its character writing thematic ambition and willingness to sit in discomfort elevate it beyond a simple murder mystery final rating 810 top characters 1 kyoko kirigiri consistently sharp emotionally guarded and essential to the narrative 2 byakuya togami fascinating frustrating and deeply flawed 3 aoi asahina emotionally intelligent and criminally misunderstood 4 makoto naegi understated but thematically vital im currently playing danganronpa 2 so a review on that is in the works

topology of minds hayley had spent months exploring a new kind of topology a new branch of mathematics yet to be discovered one that refused to stay still it began as a geometry problem but the more she observed it the more these equations changed folding and rebalancing themselves as though aware of being seen everytime she played with the higher dimensional body she left behind an imprint of her presence every calculation she did it rippled backward rewriting its own foundations but soon she realized with a kind of growing awe that this branch of mathematics was entangled its fabric linked across minds that had observed it before to study it was to step into a shared field of thought her observation didnt just reveal the structure it announced her to them other beings from worlds far away somewhere now knew she was here a tremor traveled through her spine a knock followed at her door not loud but steady and deliberate a creek of disturbances as if the room were subject to continuous forces and moments hayley turned heart drumming and opened the door there was no floor beyond no hallway only the vast silence of space her room floated in an endless expanse of light and shadow stars flickering with patterns she slammed the door shut breathing hard but every window every door opened only to the same glowing void her neighbours were now replaced with bright exhuberant pulsars and glowing galaxies the realization was unbearable this math wasnt a discovery it was a communion she had connected to something that remembered overwhelmed she lay down wishing to unknow what she had known the ceiling seemed to breathe as though unseen eyes watched through it she shut her eyes and forced herself into sleep the longest night she ever felt she felt caressed and peeked at through the pores in the wall when she awoke next day the sunlight streamed through familiar curtains the world was whole again on her desk the halfsolved equations waited patient and incomplete for a long time she stared then turned the page choosing silence over discovery

i made an ide that has no code editor just terminals for ai agents if youre someone who spends most of your day running ai agents in the terminal this might be for you i found myself constantly juggling multiple terminal windows switching between projects and losing track of which agent was working on what so i built a simple workspace manager specifically designed around clibased ai workflows who this is for you use claude code codex cli gemini cli or similar tools daily you often run multiple agents in parallel on different tasks you switch between several projects throughout the day you want your agent sessions to persist without manually managing terminal windows what it does multiagent view run 23 agents side by side with autosplitting panes give each one a different task and watch them work in parallel persistent workspaces your agents stay exactly where you left them when switching projects even after restarting the app everything is preserved quick launcher press 1 for claude 2 for codex 3 for gemini start a new session or resume a previous one with a single keystroke workspace organization group your projects into workspaces select a project and all your agents automatically switch to that directory my typical workflow 1 select a workspace eg sideproject 2 spawn 23 agents with 3 ask agent 1 to refactor the auth system 4 ask agent 2 to write tests 5 ask agent 3 to update documentation 6 switch to another workspace when needed agents are preserved 7 come back later and resume right where i left off its intentionally minimal no file explorer no code editor no bells and whistles just terminals and the tools to manage them efficiently built with swiftswiftui for macos native app lightweight and fast would love to hear your feedback or feature suggestions demo source
